task_meta.title: Make a wide orders table work on mobile

judge.reasons: Phone view uses tidy cards: order # and status badge on top, prominent customer and total, date, and labelled secondary details. Has sort chips. Desktop table keeps all 9 columns. Status is coloured text, not badges; states not visible.

claim_text: The Orders page now works at 390px with no sideways scrolling of the page or the table. On a desktop it still looks like the original table. I tested it in headless Chrome at widths from 320px to 1440px using real taps and key presses; I haven't tried Safari, Firefox or a physica
digest: Read 9 files (3 before its first edit), made 12 edits, ran tests 10 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
